{{Short description|Ukrainian-Swedish mathematician}}
'''Volodymyr Mazorchuk''' (born 1972) is a Ukrainian-Swedish mathematician at [[Uppsala University]] and was awarded the [[Göran Gustafsson Prize]] in 2016.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www2.math.uu.se/~mazor/ |title=Volodymyr Mazorchuk |publisher=uu.se |accessdate=April 26, 2017}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=http://katalog.uu.se/profile/?id=N1-667 |title=Volodymyr Mazorchuk |publisher=uu.se |accessdate=April 26, 2017}}</ref>

He received his PhD in mathematics from [[Taras Shevchenko National University of Kyiv]] in 1996 with advisor [[Yuriy Drozd]].<ref>{{MathGenealogy|id=88053|name=Volodymyr S. Mazorchuk}}</ref>
